name: month_successor
description: Name the month that follows (or is k months after) a given month. Control: same format with number successor.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
M=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December']
items=[];ctrl=[]
shot="Q: What month comes after June?\nA: July\nQ: What month comes after October?\nA: November\n"
nshot="Q: What number comes after 6?\nA: 7\nQ: What number comes after 10?\nA: 11\n"
for r in range(10):
  for i in range(12):
    items.append({"prompt":shot+f"Q: What month comes after {M[i]}?\nA:","answer":" "+M[(i+1)%12]})
for n in range(1,121):
    ctrl.append({"prompt":nshot+f"Q: What number comes after {n+11}?\nA:","answer":" "+str(n+12)})
random.shuffle(items)
items=items[:120]
json.dump({"items":items,"control":ctrl},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
